artworks.title: Sir Martin Frobisher
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing an upper-body view of a man identified as "MARTINUS FROBISHERUS" in the surrounding text. The man is depicted in a formal pose with his head turned slightly to his right, gazing forward. His facial features include a strong nose and a neatly groomed mustache and beard. His hair appears wavy and is styled neatly. He is wearing a period-appropriate outfit consisting of a doublet with intricate decoration around the shoulders and a ruff collar. The background within the oval frame is textured with dense horizontal and vertical lines. The exterior of the frame consists of plain paper with a handwritten Latin inscription below the oval. The entire image is framed by a plain, slightly textured sheet of paper.

artworks.title: Sir Martin Frobisher
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a man in historical attire with curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He wears elaborate armor over a robe, and a high collar. The background features a circular frame with inscriptions and detailed lines surrounding the figure. Below the image is a block of script.

artworks.title: Sir Martin Frobisher
artworks.description: The image depicts Sir Martin Frobisher in a three-quarter view from the knees up, standing confidently. He has a strong face with prominent eyebrows and a mustache. His short, receding hair suggests age. Frobisher wears an armor breastplate with a high ruff around his neck. A patterned doublet is visible beneath the armor. He holds a roll or rod in his right hand. A coat of arms with detailed heraldry is in the background. The rest of the background features engraved lines and a sea-faring theme. An inscription at the bottom identifies him as "St Martin Frobisher Knight" with a poetic verse.

artworks.title: Henry Garnett, Jesuit Priest
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in an ornate oval frame. The man faces the viewer with distinctive features such as a sharp, angular beard, high cheekbones, and short hair. He wears a high-collared garment, possibly a robe or coat. The frame is embellished with scrollwork and floral elements, with the letters "IHS" at the top center. Beneath the portrait, there is an inscription in Latin and English detailing the publication information, dated "Octr 21st, 1802" and attributed to William Richardson. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Henry Garnett
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a chest-up view, facing slightly to the left. The man has a round face with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, short hair, and is dressed in a dark-colored garment. The circular frame includes decorative scrollwork, symbols, and the letters "IHS." The background features ornate designs including scrolls, wreaths, and Latin text starting with "Si quid patimini propter iustitiam." The illustration appears to be an etching or engraving with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Catherine Gascoigne
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is standing with her body angled slightly towards the left, facing forward. She has refined facial features and is wearing a religious habit that completely covers her hair and neck. The clothing is traditional for a nun, with a veil and wimple. Her left hand is visible, holding a book with her index finger pointing on a page, while the right hand seems to be holding the book open. In the background, there is a crucifix to her left. The background also features a simple, textured surface with no other prominent elements. On the bottom of the image is a block of script in Latin.

artworks.title: Pierre Gassendi
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of an individual from the chest up. The person is facing slightly right with a head turned towards the viewer. The man has a receding hairline, short curly hair, a pointed beard and mustache, and a slight smile. He is wearing a dark formal robe with a white collar showing. The background features an ornate oval frame with lines radiating outwards. Below the portrait is an emblem with stars, a bird, and laurel branches, with the name "Pierre Gassendi" inscribed. The image is set against a lined, textured backdrop.

artworks.title: John of Gaunt
artworks.description: The image shows an illustrated portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing forward with a slight turn to his right, featuring a long beard, mustache, and wavy hair. The man wears a crown, ornate robe with patterns, and armor on his shoulders and arms. He holds a sword in his right hand and a helmet is nearby. The background has an intricate design with scrolls, framing the oval portrait. Text below identifies the man as Prince John of Gaunt.

artworks.title: Prince John of Gaunt, Duke of Lancaster
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait. He has long, wavy hair, a full beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a crown with a design, detailed armor, and is holding a sword. The portrait is set in an ornate oval frame with Latin inscriptions. Below the portrait, there is English text describing the man as "The most renowned Prince John of Gaunt: Duke of Lancaster," along with several titles and the year of his death, 1399.

artworks.title: John Gerard, Herbalist
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man seated, holding a stem of flowers in one hand, with the other hand partially visible. He has a short mustache, beard, pronounced cheekbones, high forehead, and cropped hair. He wears an elaborate Elizabethan outfit with a large ruffled collar, a patterned coat with buttons, and textured long sleeves. The frame around him is intricately detailed with scrollwork and text, including heraldic shields at the bottom corners. In the background, there is a plain, dark area contrasting with the detailed foreground and frame.

artworks.title: John Gerard, Herbalist
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting upright and facing forward. He has a serious expression with short, curly hair, a beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a ruffled collar, a coat with patterns, and a doublet. He holds a flower and points towards another one on a surface. The scene is framed in an oval frame with decorative elements. The background has intricate details.

artworks.title: George Frederick, Margrave of Baden
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man with a beard and mustache, styled hair, and wearing armor and a lace ruff. The background contains inscriptions and Latin text.

artworks.title: George William, Marqui of Brandenburg
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body in a three-quarter view. He has sharp features, a trimmed mustache and goatee, styled hair, and is wearing ornate clothing with a high lace ruff collar and a cloak. He holds a rod in his right hand. The portrait is set in an oval frame with decorative elements, including fruits, leaves, and cherubs holding a banner. The background is filled with floral and heraldic details.

artworks.title: Jacob de Gheyn
artworks.description: This image shows the upper body of a man seated at a table, slightly turned to the right. He has a distinguished face with prominent cheekbones, a mustache, and a short, well-trimmed beard. His hair is wavy and combed back. He is dressed in a detailed high-collared shirt, with a ruffled ruff around his neck, and a cloak draped over his shoulders. The man is holding a circular object in his left hand, while his right hand appears to rest on a drawing or painting surface. Around him on the table are various artist tools, including drawing compasses and brushes tied together. In the background, there are several smaller figures, possibly artists, engaged in drawing. The setting includes architectural elements like a column and an arched ceiling, and a detailed depiction of a wall with a chart or plan pinned to it. Below the image, text that identifies the person and provides additional context is engraved.

artworks.title: Grinling Gibbons, Wood Carver
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a person from the waist up. The individual is seated with their body slightly turned to the side, looking forward. They have long, curly hair, and wear a long-sleeved garment with wide cuffs and buttons. In their hands, they hold a sculpting tool and rest one hand on a bust resembling a classical sculpture. The background is plain and dark, and the person's name, M. Grinlin Gibbons, is at the bottom in an elegant script.

artworks.title: James Gibbs, Architect
artworks.artist: James MacArdell after John Michael Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting in a chair. He is facing slightly to the left, with his torso turned towards the viewer. The man has a full face with curly white hair falling to his shoulders. He is wearing a tailored coat, waistcoat, and a shirt with ruffled sleeves. The man is holding a writing instrument and gesturing towards a paper on the table labeled "A Plan of the Radcliffe Library." On the table, there is a set square and sheets with architectural drawings. The background is dark.

artworks.title: Sir Humphrey Gilbert
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is depicted in a seated position, turned slightly to his right but looking directly at the viewer. He has distinct facial features including a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a prominent nose, and a pointed mustache and beard. His hair is combed back, appearing wavy and short. He is dressed in a formal historical outfit featuring a high, pleated lace collar, and a doublet with a pattern that suggests layers and opulence, tied at the shoulder with a ribbon. He holds a navigational instrument in his left hand. The background of the portrait is a textured pattern framed by an oval border with text around it. The larger background is plain and off-white, resembling an aged piece of paper or parchment, which also includes additional text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Sir Humphrey Gilbert
artworks.description: In this historical illustration, there is a bust-length image of Sir Humphrey Gilbert facing towards the right. He has distinct facial features, including a styled mustache and beard, curly hair, and wears an elaborate outfit with a high collar, detailed fabric patterns, and a sash. He is holding a staff in his right hand and an armillary sphere in his left hand. The background shows a seascape with a sailing ship and the coast labeled as "Virginia" on the right. Above him is a coat of arms and inscriptions, including his name.

artworks.title: Henry, Duke of Gloucester
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the chest up. The person faces forward with a calm expression, looking directly at the viewer. They have long, wavy dark hair that falls over their shoulders, framing their face. The individual is dressed in armor with intricate detailing and a white lace cravat around their neck. The frame is ornately decorated with a leaf motif. In the background, there is draped fabric and a column, hinting at a classical setting. Below the portrait is an ornate coat of arms.

artworks.title: Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a man displaying his upper torso and head. He is positioned slightly angled to the right but his face is turned towards the viewer. The man has a distinguished facial structure with a closely-cropped beard and mustache. His hair appears to be curly and short. He is wearing a garment with intricate details and embellished buttons down the front, accentuated by a large ruff around his neck. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image. The background is an oval frame with text encircling it, and additional text in a formal script style surrounds the portrait.

artworks.title: Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, in a three-quarter view facing left. He has curly, short hair, a beard, and a mustache. His facial expression is calm, looking directly at the viewer. He wears a garment typical of the Renaissance era with a high collar. The background is an oval frame with dense crosshatching. Inscriptions in Latin mention "Henricus Goltzius." The bottom of the print includes additional writing.

artworks.title: Hendrik Goltzius, Pictor et Sculptor
artworks.description: The image shows an older man with facial features facing forward. He has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, a long beard, and a well-groomed mustache. He wears a cap and a heavy cloak or robe, holding a sheet of paper with an illustration. The background is plain and dark, with Latin text engraved at the bottom indicating his name, "Henricus Goltzius Pictor et Sculptor," and additional details.

artworks.title: Hubert Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man looking directly at the viewer. He has defining facial features including a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a full beard with a mustache. The man has short, curly, dark hair and wears a high-collared ruff, paired with a buttoned doublet featuring ornate detailing. The background is plain with an oval border containing encircling text. The tone is monochromatic, resembling a classical engraving.

artworks.title: Count Gondamor, Sarmiento de Acuna
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man. He is positioned facing slightly to the right with his facial features including a mustache and full beard. He is wearing a formal garment with a high, ruffled collar and a chain with a large pendant around his neck. The portrait is set within an oval frame with inscriptions, surrounded by a textured rectangular panel, all on an off-white background.
